name: room-booking-webapp

dependencies.name: room-booking-api
dependencies.description: Loads rooms and availability, creates and cancels bookings, manages rooms.

description: The single browser app for both roles: staff browse rooms and a day's availability, book consecutive slots and manage their own bookings; the facilities admin manages rooms and cancels bookings from the day view. It is one bundle because both roles share one lifecycle; it holds no data of its own.
